items.title: The specialization and cospecialization maps fit into a commutative diagram of cohomology groups
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the commutativity of the square relating the specialization and cospecialization maps (statement lines 19468-19481). The proof (proof lines 19483-19504) reduces to the strictly henselian case, where the maps simplify, identifies the composite of sp with the base change map as the map induced by beta on cohomology using the description of the stalk of the pushforward, and reads off the commutativity since cosp inverts the same identification. H2: one reduction and one identification, written out.
